thread:
nina: Heads-up: provenance verifier failed for a rebuilt base layer in staging. We need a quick triage and containment plan.
rob: Which layer and what mismatch?
cheng: Layer sha256:bd12... Verifier log shows unexpected annotation on signature metadata: extra field 'builder_tag'.
secops: Can you paste the verifier tail?
cheng: verifier: ERROR: signature attributes mismatch: expected {signer:redwood-sign,image_digest:sha256:bd12...} got {signer:redwood-sign,image_digest:sha256:bd12...,builder_tag:ci-1234}
policy-bot: Note: SEC-PROV-3 requires any signing metadata changes to be audited and approved.
nina: Two options: relax verifier to ignore unknown attrs (fast) or strip non-essential annotations during signing (safer). Thoughts?
rob: Strip annotations at signer. Relaxing weakens guarantees.
cheng: Agreed. I'll update signer to remove freeform annotations and add required audit_correlation_id to the signature envelope.
secops: We also need unified correlation IDs across KMS envelope logs and attestations. I'll own the collector change to ensure audit_correlation_id flows to SIEM.
deploy-bot: Tentative quickfix window 2026-04-06 03:00-04:00 UTC.
policy-bot: Ensure retention 365d for provenance logs before deploy.
nina: Action items: cheng: strip annotations + schema bump; rob: RBAC check to prevent operator from mutating sign requests; secops: collector mapping; policy-bot: retention confirmation. Post PRs here.
rob: I'll draft a ClusterRole limiting signer invocation to infra:sa:image-signer and add a namespace label gate.
cheng: Will run canary: sign one minimal image with new schema and run verify pipeline.
secops: I'll run correlation smoke test in sandbox and attach logs.
nina: If canary passes, we'll roll. If it fails, rollback plan is to re-run builder with cleaned signing step and block promotion.
policy-bot: Filing SEC-531 to track compliance artifacts.
rob: Thanks, will ping when RBAC PR is up.
nina: Closing till PRs + canary results. :white_check_mark:
